60-mm hand thermobaric grenade RG-60TB is designed to engage manpower, unsheltered on the ground, in various types of shelters and closed buildings. The grenade has a plastic oval body and remote fuse action with UZRGM mechanism. The weight of the basic structure - 240g. TNT equivalent composition 0.55-0.66 kg. The radius of destruction is 7m.
 
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Blast power: %c[ui_gray_1]medium (thermal damage)
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Blast radius: %c[ui_gray_1]7 m
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Fragments' radius: %c[ui_gray_1]none
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Av. number of fragments: %c[ui_gray_1]none
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] Explosion delay: %c[ui_gray_1]~4 seconds
